comment: Synthetic golden cases for the fact extractor (D38). `reply` is a canned model answer used by the offline parsing test; `expected` is the reference output used both there and, when M3M0S_GOLDEN_LIVE=1, to compare a real model/prompt against it.

cases.name: mixed natures in one note
cases.input: We decided to store sessions in Postgres instead of Redis because backups are simpler. Always run migrations before deploying. The failing job was caused by a missing timezone in the container. Branch feature/login is currently waiting for review.
cases.reply: {"facts":[{"text":"Sessions are stored in Postgres instead of Redis because backups are simpler.","kind":"decision"},{"text":"Always run migrations before deploying.","kind":"rule"},{"text":"The failing job was caused by a missing timezone in the container.","kind":"gotcha"},{"text":"Branch feature/login is waiting for review.","kind":"state"}]}

expected.text: Sessions are stored in Postgres instead of Redis because backups are simpler.
The failing job was caused by a missing timezone in the container.
Branch feature/login is waiting for review.

cases.name: kind casing and padding are normalized
cases.input: To reset the dev database run make reset-db and then make seed.
cases.reply: {"facts":[{"text":"To reset the dev database run make reset-db and then make seed.","kind":"  Procedure "}]}

expected.text: To reset the dev database run make reset-db and then make seed.

cases.name: provider ignored the schema (bare strings carry no kind)
cases.input: The user prefers short commit messages.

expected.text: The user prefers short commit messages.
